title: Isolation, structure and magnetic properties of two novel core–shell 3d–4f heterometallic nanoscale clusters

synthesis.procedure: Nd2O3, Ni(OAc)2·4H2O, iminodiacetic acid and NaCl were stirred in water and ethanol for 12 h at room temperature. The solution was adjusted to pH 5.0 with 1 M aqueous HCl, sealed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave and heated under autogenous pressure at 180 °C for 8 days. After cooling, the blue square-slice crystals were filtered, washed with ethanol and dried at room temperature for 24 h.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature during stirring; 180 °C during hydrothermal treatment
synthesis.time: 12 h stirring; 8 days heating; 24 h drying
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave; hydrothermal synthesis under autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; blue square-slice crystals filtered, washed with ethanol and dried at room temperature.

properties.summary: Temperature-dependent susceptibility indicates dominant antiferromagnetic exchange.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete dumbbell-shaped cluster made from two {Nd19Ni21} core–shell units joined by a {NiO6} unit. Each unit has an inner hemispherical {Nd19} core and an outer bowl-like {Ni21} shell; the reported Ni42.5 composition reflects partial occupancy.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the procedure for 1, replacing Nd2O3 with Pr4O11 (0.1663 g, 0.16 mmol). Thus Pr4O11, Ni(OAc)2·4H2O, iminodiacetic acid and NaCl were stirred in water and ethanol for 12 h at room temperature; the solution was adjusted to pH 5.0 with 1 M aqueous HCl and heated in a sealed 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave under autogenous pressure at 180 °C for 8 days. Blue square-slice crystals were obtained after cooling and the work-up described for 1.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature during stirring; 180 °C during hydrothermal treatment

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Blue square-slice crystals obtained; shared procedure for 1 specifies cooling, filtration, ethanol washing and drying at room temperature.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete bowknot-shaped cluster with a {Pr42} core encapsulated by two bowl-like {Ni19} shells. The core comprises two {Pr19} units connected by two {Pr2} units and carbonate bridges.
